# Kairav Studio

> Design-Led Technology Studio engineering world-class web applications, mobile platforms, design systems, and generative engine optimization (GEO).

Kairav Studio (https://kairav.studio) is a boutique engineering and design studio based in Indonesia, serving global clients. We merge high-conviction editorial aesthetics with high-performance systems architecture. Built with Astro v6, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, and GSAP.

## Primary Pages
- [Home](https://kairav.studio/): Overview of studio capabilities, operating board, and core systems.
- [Services](https://kairav.studio/services): Deep dive into our core practices: Design Systems, Web Applications, Mobile Engineering, Cloud Architecture, and GEO.
- [About Studio](https://kairav.studio/about): Philosophy, ethos, tech stack, and studio origin.
- [Teams & Collaborators](https://kairav.studio/teams): Studio network, core engineering, design contributors, and partners.
- [Insights & Technical Writing](https://kairav.studio/insights): Articles on software architecture, open source, performance engineering, and generative engine optimization.
- [Contact & Inquiries](https://kairav.studio/contact): Project inquiries, scope estimates, and direct studio communication.

## Core Capabilities
- **Design Systems & Editorial Interfaces**: Tokenized design systems, Figma-to-code pipelines, typography hierarchy, micro-motion.
- **High-Performance Web Applications**: Astro, Next.js, Vite, React, SSR/SSG architectures, sub-second load times.
- **Cross-Platform Mobile Apps**: Flutter and React Native architectures with offline-first synchronization.
- **Systems & Cloud Infrastructure**: Scalable backend APIs (Go, Node.js), PostgreSQL, Docker, Linux, CI/CD automation.
- **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**: AI search engine discoverability, structured data (JSON-LD), llms.txt integration, semantic indexing.
